tests.criteria: Production next build --webpack and lint/typecheck pass on exactly the integrated head; production defaults and authority guards unchanged.
Independent witnesses, invalid inputs, rejected versions and source substitutions, zero/complex/structured fidelity and registered engine hashes match.
Revalidate Day 1 inputs, result projections, browser save/replay, batch and exports under the cumulative adapter. No claim of exact-source receipt reuse for this changed dependency.
Only #474 admitted; five reference profiles remain isolated. Revalidate units, values, native switch and authorization.
Genuine disposable auth, role and plan checks, foreign account/tenant denial, and live membership/reviewer revocation under the same session.
Owned history/scenarios restore after reload, retained versions and packet tags still resolve, tampering and wrong versions refused. Frozen tree supports pre-existing stored data.

Verify labelled controls, keyboard/error recovery, mobile width, batch correction, and complete JSON/CSV/PDF by native readback/hash. Replay JSON; confirm output unit and exact numeric/structured behavior.

Deny shared project writes, native API/embed, jobs/webhooks by default. If separately approved, prove exact allowed tuple with role, cross-tenant denial, replay/revocation, idempotency, quota, signatures and durable audit.
Five required jobs and aggregate succeed with original deadlines at the exact candidate head. Retained isolated CI cannot satisfy this gate.
Discard or revert candidate-only source; restore frozen file hashes, preserve historical refs and records, and verify replay, RLS, publication denial and absence of migration/hosted effects.
